resources.string: New calls are kept inside CallVault until you choose a folder. Tap to open Settings.
New calls are kept inside CallVault until you choose a folder again. They are lost if you uninstall CallVault.
Choose a recording folder and they are saved there. They are lost if you uninstall CallVault.
Space for waiting calls is almost full. Choose a recording folder now. Waiting calls are lost if you uninstall CallVault.
No space left for waiting calls, so new calls are not recorded. Choose a recording folder now.
They are in your recording folder now.
